_comment: Data Reconciliation config, PER SERVER (copy to reconciliation.json, gitignored). Report definitions themselves live in the DB table ols_recon_report_config (per scope DB) — this file holds only the non-secret, per-server bits: the base folder where report extract CSVs land (FILE mode), the TABLE-mode staging table, and the mapping from the monitoring-batches status column values to our three side-states. Any key left out falls back to the defaults below, then to the legacy RECON_* .env var.
